Experienced engineers

Your next role, from people who know engineering

We only contact you about roles that match your skills, and we never send your CV to a company without your OK.

  1. Home
  2. Experienced engineers

Sound familiar?

What gets in the way

  • Irrelevant roles

    Recruiters call you about roles that have little to do with your skills, your level or what you want next.

  • A CV sent without asking

    You don’t know which companies have seen your CV, or who sent it to them.

  • The details come last

    The contract, the package and the way of working only become clear after several rounds of interviews.

  • A CV nobody reads properly

    The person screening you can’t tell your specialism from a similar-sounding one, so the conversation stays on the surface.

Why us

Why work with us

  • Only roles that fit

    We contact you about roles in your discipline and at your level, never a list of everything we have open.

  • Your CV, your decision

    We never send your CV to a company without your OK, and you always know which company receives it.

  • Interviews with engineers

    Your technical interview is with an engineer who knows your discipline, so the conversation goes into real detail.

Ways to work

Permanent or project-based

  • A permanent role

    You join the company as its employee. We clarify the role, the package and the way of working before your first interview, and support you through the offer.

  • Project work as a freelancer

    You work through your own business on a project or consulting contract, with the scope, duration and rate agreed in writing before you start.

Our services

How we can help you

  • Acquire

    Talent acquisition

    Permanent roles in your discipline, and we only contact you about the ones that match your skills and goals.

  • Bridge

    Temporary staffing

    Project work as a freelancer with your own business, with scope, duration and rate agreed before the project starts.

  • Secure

    Succession planning

    When a company has no internal successor for a critical role, we also look outside, which can mean a senior or leadership role for you.

  • Map

    Competence mapping

    When a company maps its competences with us, the roles it opens start from a precise profile of the skills needed, not a vague job title.

  • Develop

    University talent programme

    Our programme for students and recent graduates, if you know someone who is just starting out.

How it works

What happens, step by step

  1. 01

    Your CV

    Apply for a role or send us your CV. A recruiter who knows your discipline reads it.

  2. 02

    First conversation

    We talk about your experience, what you want next, and the contract and package you expect.

    Typical duration
    30 minutes

  3. 03

    Technical interview

    An engineer who knows your discipline talks through your work and the competences the role needs.

    Typical duration
    60–90 minutes

  4. 04

    Introduction to the company

    Only with your OK, we present your profile with a written assessment, and tell you which company receives it.

    Typical duration
    3–5 working days

  5. 05

    Interviews and offer

    We prepare you for the company’s interviews, share feedback on both sides and support you through the offer.

    Typical duration
    2–3 weeks

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Which roles do you have in my discipline?

We work in software & IT, cybersecurity, and mechanical & industrial engineering. The jobs page lists every open role, and you can filter it by discipline.

Permanent or contract?

Both. We hire for permanent roles, and we find project work for freelance engineers and technical consultants who run their own business.

Can I work remotely or hybrid?

It depends on the role. Every job ad states whether it is on site, hybrid or remote, and we confirm the arrangement in the first conversation.

How does contract work for freelancers?

You work independently as a freelancer with your own business, under a project or consulting contract. The scope, duration and rate are agreed clearly before the project starts.

What happens to my CV?

It stays with us and is handled in line with GDPR. We never send it to a company without your explicit OK, and you always know which company receives it.

Do I pay anything?

No. Candidates never pay anything for our services.
